parsed.lessons_learned: In Uniswap V3, when current tick equals tick_upper of your position, you are at the exact boundary and LP is effectively inactive for upward price movement. Always set tick_upper above current tick, not equal to it. Also: always check tokens_owed before removing positions - there were 236 USDT in uncollected fees sitting there multiple cycles. Collect fees every cycle on active positions.
